name: table
description: A table is a structured way of displaying data organized in rows and columns. Each row represents a data entity, and each column represents an attribute or field. Tables can clearly display large amounts of data, making it easy for users to search, compare, and analyze. Tables are typically used to display structured data, such as financial statements, report cards, product lists, etc. The core advantage of a table is alignment and comparison. Users can quickly locate data in a specific row or column for horizontal or vertical comparison. Tables also support operations such as sorting and filtering, enhancing data usability and interactivity. Applicable scenarios: 1. Displaying structured data, such as details, lists, reports, etc.; 2. When data needs to be searched, sorted, filtered, or compared; 3. When the amount of data is large, and each piece of data has multiple attributes.

data.description: Data for the table, which is an array of objects. Each object represents a row in the table.
